note: Game globals by name (SDK 16, hellforge_globals.h): cells in a module's data that hold a pointer to one of the game's objects (a manager, a queue), and the fields of that object the research has named. witnesses: 1 to 3 instructions of the game's code that load the cell (rva, and its bytes with the ones after it); the generator checks that each points at the cell, and the loader that one of them reads as reviewed before it hands the cell out (two, so a later patch over one of them does not lose the global). aliases: former names the loader still resolves (a renamed global keeps working for mods built with its old name; functions.json has them too). Offsets are from the start of the object. The loader resolves them only on this build: a new game build revalidates every entry.

Game.meaning: The Game: the session's top object, whose state the game's ChangeState (game.dll+0xAB2FA0) sets

state.meaning: the game's state (HF_STATE_...; hf->game_state reads it)

Game.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-state; HellForge's HF_ON_STATE poll (event_sources.c)

PlayerManager.meaning: The players of the session. Per slot i (0 to count - 1): the peer id at +0x2C8 + 0x38 i (u64), its lifecycle at +0x2E0 + 0x38 i (u32: 2 waiting to respawn, 3 spawned), its player entity at [+0xE8 + 8 i] + 8 (u32), its Helldiver's network id at +0x3A8 + 0x20 i. Slots move as players leave: tell players apart by peer id
PlayerManager.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-mission; HellForge's HF_ON_PLAYER_SPAWN poll (event_sources.c)

LocalUser.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-mission; HellForge's local player (event_sources.c)

mission.meaning: the mission's data: +0x14 bit 0 set on the host, +8 the game mode's entity (u32)

GameMode.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-actions; HellForge's actions (actions.c ActMission)

EntityManager.meaning: The entities of this machine's world. At +0xF22EC8 a hash map of network ids to slots (8-byte keys, 4-byte values), and at +0xF32F20 the network objects by slot, 24 bytes each (+0 the entity id, u32); at +0xF1AEB0 the map of entity ids, at +0xF32F18 their descriptors
EntityManager.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-combat; HellForge's event polls (event_polls.c)

HealthManager.meaning: Every entity's health. At +0x1030 a hash map of entity ids to indexes (8-byte keys, 4-byte values); an index's descriptor names its entity (+0 resource u64, +8 entity u32, +12 unit, +16 network id, +20 bit 0 owned here); its record holds health (i32) at +0x14 and its life (u32: 0 alive, 1 downed, 2 or more dead) at +0x19C; its ext record the maximum health (i32) at +0x14

descriptors.meaning: an array of descriptor pointers, by index

records.meaning: the health records, 0x1B8 bytes each, by index

ext.meaning: the ext records, 0x1C bytes each, by index

HealthManager.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-combat; HellForge's HF_ON_HEAL poll (event_polls.c) and heal (actions.c)

MotionManager.meaning: Entities that move. At +0x48A0 a hash map of entity ids to indexes (8-byte keys, 4-byte values); an index's descriptor names its entity at +8 (u32) and has bit 0 of +0x14 set while it is live; its record starts with its velocity (3 floats, m/s)

descriptors.meaning: an array of descriptor pointers, by index

records.meaning: the motion records, 0x84 bytes each, by index

ExplosionQueue.meaning: The explosion requests of this frame: RequestExplosion's queue

count.meaning: requests queued (256 at most: RequestExplosion refuses more)

ProjectileSystem.meaning: The projectiles in flight: FireProjectile's system and the projectile pool
ProjectileSystem.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research projectile-ballistics; HellForge's spawn_projectile and shot rules (actions.c)

CombatQueues.meaning: This frame's damage and status requests, which the frame's drain applies (QueueDamage, QueueStatusRequest)
CombatQueues.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-combat; HellForge's injure and apply_status (actions.c)

ScoreManager.meaning: The players' mission stats. At +0x37D58 a map of player entities to indexes; the index's record at +0x37D98 + 0x28 index: a stat table, and 64 source blocks of 0x148 bytes at [record + 0x18], each a resource and 16 stat entries (HF_STAT_...)
ScoreManager.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-mission; HellForge's HF_ON_STAT poll (event_polls.c)

WielderManager.meaning: What entities hold. At +0x30 a map of entities to instances; an instance's slot 0 (its hand) at [+0x60] + 0x1D0 instance

slots.meaning: the instances' slots, 0x1D0 bytes per instance

WielderManager.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-wielder; HellForge's HF_ON_WEAPON poll (event_polls.c)

InventoryManager.meaning: The Helldivers' inventories. At +0x28 a map of entities to records; a record's inventory selection at +0x1C (u32: 1 primary, 2 secondary, 3 support, 4 or 5 a held item)
InventoryManager.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-wielder; HellForge's HF_ON_WEAPON poll (event_polls.c)

Destructibles.meaning: The world's destructible objects. Their descriptor pointers at +0x4030 and world indexes at +0x6030, one per destructible
Destructibles.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-destruction; HellForge's HF_ON_BUGHOLE poll (event_polls.c)

DestructionRecords.meaning: The destruction state of the world's destructibles: records of 12 bytes at +0xC5F78 by world index (+0 unit, +7 stage u8, +8 bit 0 registered)
DestructionRecords.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-destruction; HellForge's HF_ON_BUGHOLE poll (event_polls.c)
